text: WHY THIS MATTERS
The model makes capture conversational. The system makes results auditable. That is what lets AI participate in a high-trust home decision without becoming the final authority.
textPreview: The model makes capture conversational. The system makes results auditable. That is what lets AI participate in a high-trust home decisio...

text: Technical proof for judges: native RoomPlan capture and USDZ backup, direct Realtime PCM transport with server-minted ephemeral secrets, bounded consumer-capability policy, Zod-validated SiteGraph events, evidence registry, deterministic engineering and cost contracts, explicit insufficient_data and partial-range states, and regression checks. This directly addresses technical sophistication and reliability in the official DNHacks rubric: https://portal.dnhacks.org/e/2026/judging
